4B)              A conductor, with 1000 turns, is wound on the central limb of a cast iron magnetic circuit, having a        (6)

  in the 2 mm air gap. (Neglect leakage and fringing)  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"
